_comment: Git-tracked manifest of GPU-exclusive / model-unloaded offline jobs the watchdog can run. The watchdog re-reads this on every request, so adding or changing a job is a repo edit + `git pull` — no watchdog restart (which would need SSH). Each job: `cmd` is the argv passed after the python executable (a module via ["-m", "pkg.mod"] or a script filename, run from server/); `progress` (optional) is a JSONL progress journal filename served via GET /job/progress; `log` (optional) is where stdout/stderr is appended (default <name>.log); `sync: true` runs the job to completion and returns its stdout JSON result instead of returning immediately. The POST /job/<name> body's `args` list is appended verbatim to `cmd` — the caller forms the job-specific flags, the watchdog stays semantics-free.

train.description: Offline LoRA train cycle (stops inference to free the GPU).

wipe.description: Destructive disaster recovery: delete regenerable state, repoint the base model.

backfill_hidden.description: Teacher-forced replay of stored exchanges into `.hidden.npz` variant groups (base by default; args e.g. ["--limit", "100"]).

axis_controls.description: Hostility and vocabulary controls for the stored axes (base by default; ["--with-adapter"] for the adapter). Report under data/axes/controls/.

extract_axes.description: Affective-axis extraction from axes/contrast_sets.json with the five gates (base by default; args e.g. ["--only", "pain"]); the replaced file is archived under data/axes/prev/.

thought_hygiene.description: Thought hygiene over the corpus (core/thought_hygiene.py): the frozen base marks the lines of each training target's thought that only recite her description, and the cut target trains (["--trial", "30"] writes a review sheet and changes nothing).

persona_hygiene.description: Persona hygiene over the persona store (core/persona_hygiene.py): the frozen base reads each [persona] statement, and one that describes a habit of hers instead of a disposition she stands by is withheld from recall, the digest and training (["--judge-only"] writes verdicts and changes nothing; ["--apply-only"] applies the standing verdicts).

reset_redecide.description: The reset test's applied decisions re-read under the rule now (core/reset_test.py redecide_plan): the [persona] positions the retro superseded that pass now are restored; withheld ones are only listed. GPU-free; writes the live op-log and ledger, so inference is stopped around it.

axis_variants.description: Residuals of every contrast / gate set at every layer for the pain-axis variants (base by default; ["--with-adapter"]); analysed GPU-free by axis_variants.py --analyze.

replay_step0.description: Step-0 axis readings under a swapped turn (orig / neutral / short / shallow / shallow_neutral), adapter and base. Report under data/axes/controls/ (args e.g. ["--targets", "<stem>#<i>,..."]).

portrait_hygiene.description: Portrait hygiene trial: the frozen base reads a sample of her [impression] readings of a person against that person's own messages (args ["--person", NAME, "--trial", "40"]); verdicts to data/hygiene/portrait.jsonl, a review sheet under data/hygiene/trials/. Changes nothing in her stores.

prefill_memory.description: Diagnostic: the clean base's prefill memory by prompt length, each attention call's peak by head_dim (which SDPA path gemma-4's global layers take) and the production generate path → data/measure/prefill_memory_<ts>.json. Changes nothing.

axis_reply_baseline.description: Where the affect channels (harm_l / warm_l / amuse_l band means) sit on her own reply tokens: live-sample exchanges replayed teacher-forced under the serving adapter (["--with-adapter"] or ["--adapter", DIR]; ["--limit", N]) → data/axes/reply_baseline.json, which the chat colouring centres the per-token channels on.

panel_base.description: The base's own reading of a nightly-measurement panel (args ["warmth"]): the bare base reads the capture bench's frozen contexts at step 0 → data/measure/<panel>_panel_base.json, the report's reference. Changes nothing else.

axis_checks.description: Checks on the step-0 axes (args ["steer", …] or ["label", "--turns", GAP_JSON]): the steering check (each channel's direction added at layer 28, her replies judged blind by the base) or the frozen base's labels on the corpus's real turns → data/axes/checks/. Findings only.

governor_reference.description: The habit governor's reference: the base (or ["--adapter", DIR]) answers the frozen live sample through each turn's stored seam with the live chat's sampling and guards → data/measure/governor_reference.jsonl; read GPU-free by python -m core.governor.
